page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with canon citations set as paragraph openings. No margin notes. Catchword "Idem" at lower right.

p.i: fam Non esse celebrandam. Ex Concil. Aurel.

main_text.p: De Con. Dist.1.C.Vnicuique.)Vnicuique fi-delium in domo sua oratorium licet habere, & ibi orare, missas autem ibi celebrare non licet.

p.i: Fidelem etiam ante perceptionem eucharistiæ morientem salvari posse.

main_text.p: De Con. Dist.2.C.Nulli.) Nulli est aliquantenus dubitandum, unumquemque fideliū, corporis & sanguinis Dominici tunc esse participem, quando in baptismate membrum effici-tur Christi, nec alienari ab illius panis calicisq; confortio, etiamsi antequam panem illum comedat calicemque bibat, de hoc seculo migraverit, in unitate corporis Christi constitutus. Sacramenti quippe illius participatione ac beneficio non privabitur, quando in se hoc quod illud sacramentum significat invenitur.

p.i: Excommunicandos, qui usque ad fi-nem missarum solennia non audierint, neque communionem perceperint.

main_text.p: De Con. Dist.1.C. Omnes fideles.) Omnes fideles qui conveniunt in solennitatibus sacris ad ecclesiam, & scripturas apostolorum & evan-gelium audient: Qui vero non perseverant in oratione usq; dum missa peragatur, nec sancta communione percipiunt, velut inquietudines ecclesiae commovētes convenit communione privari.

page.notes: "ibi" in the second canon carries a superscript mark over the "i" (appears as "ibį"); read as "ibi". "Qui" in "Qui vero" is underlined in the print. "fideliū" carries a macron over the final u, read as "fideliū". "sancta" is written with an abbreviation-like mark over the a; read as "sancta". "commovētes" has a tilde over the e, read as printed. Long s was rendered as plain s throughout. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. The running head is set in spaced capitals and ends in a hyphen that joins to the italic word "fam" at the start of the page.
